name: How long does the typical pergola design and installation process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the typical pergola design and installation process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for pergola design and installation varies based on complexity, size, material choice, and permitting requirements. Typically, the design phase can take 1-3 weeks, involving consultations and revisions. Once the design is finalized and permits are secured (if needed, which can add several weeks), the actual installation usually spans 1-3 weeks. Factors like site preparation, custom features, and weather can influence the overall duration. We aim to keep you informed at every stage to ensure a smooth and efficient project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The typical pergola project, from design to installation, usually takes 4-8 weeks, depending on complexity, materials, and permitting.
